claims: Yellowstone National Park was established in 1872.
Yellowstone National Park is the first U.S. National Park.
Yellowstone National Park spans over 2.2 million acres.
Yellowstone National Park is located in Wyoming, Montana, and Idaho.
Yellowstone National Park contains over half the world’s active geysers.
Old Faithful is a geyser in Yellowstone National Park.
The Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone is in Yellowstone National Park.
Grand Prismatic Spring is in Yellowstone National Park.
Norris Geyser Basin is in Yellowstone National Park.
Lamar Valley is in Yellowstone National Park.
Hayden Valley is in Yellowstone National Park.
Yellowstone Canyon is in Yellowstone National Park.
Yellowstone Falls is in Yellowstone National Park.
Yellowstone Lake is in Yellowstone National Park.
Visitors must maintain at least 100 yards from bears and wolves in Yellowstone National Park.
Visitors must maintain at least 25 yards from other wildlife in Yellowstone National Park.
A fee is required for entry to Yellowstone National Park.
The entrance fee is usually valid for 7 days.
Nine lodges operate in Yellowstone National Park during summer.
Old Faithful Inn is a lodge in Yellowstone National Park.
Canyon Lodge is a lodge in Yellowstone National Park.
West Yellowstone is in MT.
Gardiner is in MT.
Cooke City is in MT.
Jackson is in WY.
All roads and facilities are open in Yellowstone National Park from June to August.
